openDecisions.question: For overlapping sections 7-12, should runtime data expose Vikingaleden as a separate trail with its own route geometry files, or as route aliases over canonical Upplandsleden section geometry?
Should shared facilities on the Upplandsleden overlap be owned by a cross-trail canonical facility/place record with both trail sectionRefs, or duplicated per trail after dedupe?
Should parking and transit stay out of normal facilities unless an access layer exists, matching the Upplandsleden dedupe policy?
Should Stormon/Grillholmen and other branch/context amenities remain pending until branch handling is settled?
Should rule-warning rows be preserved as visible planning warnings if the app has a rule-warning layer, or remain suppressed/context-only?
